text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Should I have her focus on getting better or push through the pain…
choice_data_list: Pain is weakness leaving the body!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to focus on getting her injuries treated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> seems to be feeling a little depressed because she can't get any exercise…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no time to waste! I harden my heart and decide to have <chrname> push through the pain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she forces herself too hard and her injury worsens…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the injury is miraculously healed! Practice goes perfectly!
